errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart. The vertical axis lists the types of employment (categories), while the horizontal axis represents the values.
The bars are sorted in ascending order of their values, from top to bottom (2,447, 2,853, 3,020, etc.).
The category 'Работа на смени' (Shift work) is not present in the chart.

errors.evidence: The vertical axis is not labeled with a single title. 'Еднодневна заетост в селското стопанство' is the first of seven categories listed along the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос...показва броя на работниците, изразено в брой (без специфични единици) и се простира от 2,447 до 6,201.
errors.evidence: The vertical axis shows the categories of employment. The values, represented by the horizontal bar lengths, range from 2,447 to 6,201.
The chart values are not explicitly defined as 'number of workers'. The original paper caption states they are 'evaluations by workers', implying a score or rating rather than a count.
The chart uses horizontal bars, so their 'length' increases, not their 'height'.

errors.evidence: The bar with the value 2,447 corresponds to 'Еднодневна заетост в селското стопанство' (One-day employment in agriculture), not the hallucinated category 'Временна или сезонна работа'.
